The bug was in the `do_len` closure within `Version::fmt` (src/display.rs:5). It incorrectly calculated the length of the version string by subtracting 1 from the number of digits in the major version (`digits(self.major) - 1`), which led to an incorrect padding calculation when using alignment formatting. I corrected it to `digits(self.major) + 1` (for the dot following the major version).

The bug was in the `do_len` closure within `Version::fmt` in `src/display.rs`. It was subtracting 1 from the length of the major version digits (`digits(self.major) - 1`), which caused incorrect padding when using alignment formatting. I corrected it to add 1 for each separator (dot), ensuring the calculated length matches the actual displayed string length.

The bug was in `Version::fmt` where the length calculation for padding was incorrect. Specifically, it had `- 1 + digits(self.minor) + 1`, which effectively cancelled out one of the dots between version components. I corrected this to `digits(self.major) + 1 + digits(self.minor) + 1 + digits(self.patch)`, ensuring both separators are counted in the total length.
